name: swipe-card-deck
title: Swipe Card Deck
description: A deck of stacked cards that can be dismissed by swiping left or right with angular velocity feedback.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Minimal
Macrostructure: Stack
Density: Compact
Shape: Rounded
Motion: Expressive
Typography: Grotesk
Color: High Contrast

## Rules

- Lateral Deck Decision Swipe: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
